findings.title: Default dashboard image is mutable and not reproducibly pinned
findings.what: When spec.image is omitted, the operator deploys ghcr.io/shpwrck/claude-history-dashboard:latest with ImagePullPolicy Always. A later tag move changes executable dashboard code without a reviewed operator change. That container receives the dashboard service-account token and the optional ingest secret, increasing the impact of registry/tag compromise.
findings.fix: Replace the default tag with an immutable image digest, for example ghcr.io/shpwrck/claude-history-dashboard@sha256:<release-digest>, and update that digest through the reviewed release process.
findings.acceptance: Reconcile a DashboardInstance with an empty spec.image and assert that Deployment.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image contains an @sha256: digest and does not end in :latest.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read baseline lines 69-72 and 180-183. The immutable checkout still selects :latest by default and Always pulls it; no pinning occurs in this dispatched code.

findings.title: Distress detector fails open when session-pod evidence cannot be read
findings.what: The session-pod List result is evaluated only when err == nil. On an API/RBAC/transient error, the code skips the hard-cap calculation and returns false, asserting no distress despite having no evidence for the active-pod count. This can permit new pod creation while the cap signal is unavailable.
findings.fix: Return true when listing session pods fails, matching the fail-safe behavior already used for node-list errors; only calculate and return false after both required signals were read successfully.
findings.acceptance: Add a unit test whose client succeeds listing nodes but fails listing session pods, and assert DistressProbe.sample returns true; retain tests showing a successful below-cap list returns false and an at-cap list returns true.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read baseline lines 55-87 and the declared hard-cap signal at lines 18-25. The node query explicitly fails safe, but the independent session-pod query still discards its error and reaches false; no later fallback exists in this function.
